name: cudly-mcp
description: Search and buy AWS/Azure/GCP reserved capacity (RIs, Savings Plans, CUDs) from Claude Desktop.

enable_real_purchases.title: Enable real purchases
enable_real_purchases.description: DANGER: turns on cudly-mcp's ability to execute REAL, money-spending cloud purchases (AWS Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Azure Reservations, GCP CUDs) when a client explicitly requests dry_run=false and confirm=true. Leave this off until you have exercised the dry-run path and are ready to let it spend real money.

max_count.title: Maximum count per purchase call
max_count.description: Per-call ceiling on instances/nodes (or vCPUs for GCP CUDs) for a real purchase. Required before any real purchase: leave it empty and purchases are refused. Applies per call, not cumulatively; it bounds size, not dollars (see the USD setting).

max_hourly_commitment.title: Maximum hourly commitment (USD/hour)
max_hourly_commitment.description: Per-call ceiling on a Savings Plan hourly commitment. Required before any real Savings Plan purchase. Applies per call, not cumulatively.

max_memory_gb.title: Maximum committed memory (GB)
max_memory_gb.description: Per-call ceiling on memory for a GCP CUD. Required before any real GCP CUD purchase. Applies per call, not cumulatively.

max_commitment_usd.title: Maximum commitment per purchase call (USD)
max_commitment_usd.description: Per-call ceiling on the total USD one purchase commits over its full term, priced by the provider just before buying. Required before any real purchase: leave it empty and purchases are refused. USD only; purchases that cannot be priced (including real GCP CUD purchases for now) are refused. Applies per call, not cumulatively.

budget_usd.title: Cumulative purchase budget per server process (USD)
budget_usd.description: Total USD that real purchases may commit over their full terms in one server process. Required before any real purchase: leave it empty and purchases are refused. Held in memory: it resets when the server restarts, is not shared across processes or MCP clients, and cannot see purchases made in the cloud console, CLI or elsewhere. A purchase with an unknown outcome counts as spent.

archera_api_key.title: Archera API key
archera_api_key.description: Optional. Enables the read-only Archera plan listing and comparison tools. Sent only to https://api.archera.ai. Leave empty to keep the tools disabled.

archera_org_id.title: Archera organization ID
archera_org_id.description: Optional. Archera organization UUID, used with the API key above.

archera_plan_id.title: Archera commitment plan ID
archera_plan_id.description: Optional. Archera commitment plan UUID to list or compare, used with the API key above.
